data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the maximum encumbrance of the facsimile that can be conjured by 2 per Magnitude upgrade purchased.

data.Name: Enhance Basic Power
data.Description:
When making an Athletics check, the Force user may roll an [B] Enhance power check[b] as part of the pool.

[P]The user may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

data.Name: Control: Coordination
data.Description: Enhance can be used with the Coordination skill.

data.Name: Control: Resilience
data.Description: Enhance can be used with the Resilience skill.

data.Name: Control: Force Leap (Horizontal)
data.Description: Take a Force Leap action: Make an [B]Enhanced power check[b]. The user may spend [FP] to jump horizontally to any location in short range.

data.Name: Control: Piloting - Planetary
data.Description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Planetary) skill.

data.Name: Control: Brawl
data.Description: Enhance can be used with the Brawl skill.

data.Name: Control: Force Leap (Vertical)
data.Description: When performing a Force Leap, the user can jump vertically in addition to jumping horizontally.

data.Name: Control: Piloting - Space
data.Description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Space) skill.

data.Name: Control: Brawn
data.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. The user increases his Brawn characteristic by 1 (to maximum of 6).

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Agility
data.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. The user increases his Agility characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

data.Name: Control: Force Leap (Maneuver)
data.Description: The user can perform Force Leap as a maneuver instead of an action.

data.Name: Conjure Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force user calls forth a spectral object to their hand, which lasts for a short time.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to create a facsimile of a Brawl or Melee weapon anywhere within engaged range. At the end of the user's next turn, this item dissipates. At the GM's discretion, the user can instead conjure a simple tool and other useful low-tech item with an encumbrance no greater than 1.

data.Name: Duration
data.Description: Commit [FO] to sustain 1 conjuration per Duration upgrade purchased while it remains at medium range.

data.Name: Number
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to create additional, identical conjurations equal to ranks in Number upgrade purchased.

data.Name: Control: Defensive, Deflection, Stun
data.Description: Spend [FP] to add 1 of the following weapon qualities to the conjuration: Defensive 1, Deflection 1, Stun 4.

data.Name: Control: Burn, Pierce, Vicious
data.Description: Spend [FP] to add 1 of the following weapon qualities to the conjuration: Burn 3, Pierce 3, Vicious 3.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the range at which the facsimile can be conjured and sustained by 1 (to a maximum of extreme).

data.Name: Mastery
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP][FP] to summon the facsimile of a creature of silhouette 1 or smaller instead of an object. This creature is bound to the user's will, and mindlessly follows that character's commands until the end of the Force user's next turn. If the user has the corpse of the creature being conjured to imbue with false life, this facsimile lasts until the end of the encounter instead, but the user gains 7 conflict for doing so.

data.Name: Farsight Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force user expands normal visual senses through a connection to the Force.
[BR]The user may spend [FP] to ignore the effects of darkness or blindness and see normally at up to medium range for the remainder of the round (or for one minute). This allows the user to view everything most sentients could normally be able to see on a well lit day.

data.Name: Control: Microscopic Details
data.Description: Spend [FP] to see microscopic details of a single object within engaged range.

data.Name: Control: Transparent
data.Description: Spend [FP] to see through a single object at medium range as though it were transparent.

data.Name: Control: Fine Details
data.Description: Spend [FP] to make out fine details on a single object within medium range.

data.Name: Duration
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase duration by number of rounds for minutes equal to Druation upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by one range band equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Vigilance
data.Description: When making a Vigilance or Perception check, make a Farsight power check as part of the pool and spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] on the check.

data.Name: Control: Perception
data.Description: This power gains the ongoing effect: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the Farshigh power to increase ranks in Perception by 1.

data.Name: Control: Panoramic Vision
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to see in every direction simultaneously, noticing and observing things in a full 360 degree arc.

data.Name: Mastery
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP]. The user now can see as though from a spot within close range (planetary scale) of the user's body.

data.Name: Foresee Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force user can feel the Force flowing around everything, seeing what is and what will be.

[P] The user may spend [FP] to gain vague hints of events to come, up to a day into his own, personal future.

data.Name: Control: Initiative (Success)
data.Description: When making a skill check to determine Initiative, the user may roll a [B] Foresee power check[b] as part of the pool. He may spend [FP] to gain [SU] on the check.

data.Name: Strength
data.Description: Spend [FP] to pick out specific details equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Defense
data.Description: Affected targets increase their ranged and melee defense by 2 for the first round of combat.

data.Name: Duration
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the days into the future the user can see equal to Duration upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Initiative (Maneuver)
data.Description: When performing a [B]Foresee power check[b] as part of an Initiative check, the user may spend [FP] to allow all affected targets to take one free maneuver before the first round of combat begins.

data.Name: Jerserra's Influence Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force use can project terrifying visions onto foes, forcing them to face their greatest fears.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to target one character within short range. That character must immediately make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) fear check[b] as an out of turn incidental.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Strength
data.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to increase the difficulty of the fear check by a number of times equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Strain
data.Description: If target suffers strain as a result of Jerserra's Influence, the Force user recovers an equal amount of strain.

data.Name: Control: Fear
data.Description: When making a fear check, the Force user can roll a [B]Jerserra's Influence power check[b] as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the number of targets affected by a number equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Willpower
data.Description: Ongoing effect. Commit [FO]. The user increases his Willpower characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

data.Name: Mastery
data.Description: The Force user may target one character within short range and make an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] combined with a [B]Jerserra's Influence power check[b]. If the user spends [FP] and succeeds on the check, he may commit [FO] and force the target to also commit [FO]. Both dice remain committed until the Force user uncommits that [FO] or the encounter ends.

data.Name: Mastery
data.Description: Once per session, after a target fails a fear check caused by this power, the Force user may have the target perform one action as an out of turn incidental. The Force user gains 3 Conflict.

data.Name: Move Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force user can move small objects via the power of the Force.

[P]The user may spend [FP] to move one object of silhouette 0 that is within short range up to his maximum range. The default maximum range is short range.

data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Strength
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase silhouette able to be targeted equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Control: Hurl
data.Description: The Force user can hurl objects to damage targets by making a [B]ranged combat check[b] combined with a [B]Move power check[b], dealing damage equal to 10 times silhouette.

data.Name: Control: Pull
data.Description: The Force user can pull objects out of secure mountings or out of an opponent's grasp.

data.Name: Control: Manipulate
data.Description: The character can perform fine manipulation of items, allowing him to do whatever he could normally do with his hands via this power at this power's range.

data.Name: Influence Basic Power
data.Description:
The character may attempt to guide, shape, and even twist the thoughts and feelings of other.

[P][B]Special Rule ([LI]/[DA] use)[b]: When guiding and shaping thoughts, only [FP] generated from [DA] may be used to generate negative emotions such as rage, fear, and hatred. Only [FP] generated from[LI] may be used to generate positive emotions such as peace, tranquility, and friendliness. Other emotions such as confusion can be created from [FP] generated from either [LI] or [DA].

[P]The character may spend [FP] to stress the mind of one living target he is engaged with, inflicting 1 strain.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Control: Emotion/Belief
data.Description: The Force user may make an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] combined with an [B]Influence power check[b]. If the user spends [FP] and succeeds on the check, he can force the target to adopt an emotional state or believe something untrue, lasting for 1 round or 5 minutes.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Control: Skills
data.Description: When making a Coercion, Charm, Deception, Leadership, or Negotiation check, the Force user may roll an [B]Influence power check[b] as part of his dice pool. He may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Strength
data.Description: When stressing the mind of a target, the character inflicts 2 strain.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Duration
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase duration by number of rounds (or minutes) equal to Duration upgrades purchased.
Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

data.Name: Misdirect Basic Power
data.Description:
The Force user creates illusions to fool those around him.

[P]The user may spend [FP] to make a target at up to short range unable to perceive a chosen person or object of silhouette 1 or smaller. Until the beginning of the user's next turn, the target cannot see or sense the hidden person or object.

data.Name: Range
data.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

data.Name: Duration
data.Description: Commit [FO][FO] to sustain this power while the beguiled target remains in range.

data.Name: Strength
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase the silhouette of the object obscured or illusion created by 1 per Strength upgrade purchased.

data.Name: Control: Appearance
data.Description: The user may alter the perceived appearance of the chosen person or object instead of hiding it.

data.Name: Magnitude
data.Description: Spend [FP] to affect additional targets equal to Presence per rank of Magnitude purchased.

data.Name: Control: Illusion
data.Description: May use this power to force the target to perceive a single illusory person or object.

data.Name: Control: Combat
data.Description: Commit one or more [FO]. Add [TH] per [FO] to all combat checks targeting Force user.

data.Name: Mastery
data.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to obscure additional objects or create illusions equal to Cunning plus Deception.

data.Name: Outdoorsman
data.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Outdoorsman from checks to move through terrain or manage environmental effects. Decrease overland travel times by half.

data.Name: Skilled Jockey
data.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Skilled Jockey from all Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space) checks the character attempts.

data.Name: Full Throttle
data.Description: Take a Full Throttle action; make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting check[b] to increase a vehicle's top speed by 1 for a number of rounds equal to Cunning.

data.Name: Witchcraft
data.Description: The character gains Force rating 1.

data.Name: Summon Item
data.Description: As a maneuver, the character can summon or dismiss a ritually prepared item.

data.Name: Ichor Blade
data.Description: The character chooses one Melee or Brawl weapon they possess, which gains the Cortosis and Pierce 2 qualities and reduces its critical rating by 1 to a minimum of 1. If the weapon is ever lost or destroyed, the character can apply Ichor Blade to a new weapon.

data.Name: Ichor Blade (Improved)
data.Description: The chosen weapon also gains the Sunder and Defensive 1 qualities, and increases its damage by 2.

data.Name: Grit
data.Description: Gain +1 strain threshold

data.Name: Conditioned
data.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Conditioned from Athletics and Coordination check. Reduce the damage and strain suffered from falling by 1 per rank of Conditioned.

data.Name: Short Cut
data.Description: During a chase; add [BO] per rank in Shortcut to any checks made to catch or escape an opponent.

data.Name: Full Throttle (Improved)
data.Description: Suffer 1 strain to attempt Full Throttle as a maneuver and decrease its difficultly to [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b].

data.Name: Freerunning
data.Description: Suffer 1 strain when making a Move maneuver to move to any location within short range.

data.Name: Freerunning (Improved)
data.Description: Suffer 4 strain when making a move maneuver to move to any location within medium range.

data.Name: Full Throttle (Supreme)
data.Description: When performing Full Throttle, top speed increases by 2 instead of 1.

data.Name: Force Rating
data.Description: Gain +1 Force Rating.

data.Name: Better Luck Next Time
data.Description: Take a Better Luck Next Tiem action; make a [B]Hard([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check[b] to force a competitor to suffer a major misfortune.

data.Name: Superhuman Reflexes
data.Description: Once per session, after generatin [DE] on a Piloting check cancel the [DE] and add [SU] equal to ranks in Cool.

data.Name: Dedication
data.Description: Gain +1 to a single characteristic. This cannot bring a characteristic above 6.

data.Name: Shortcut (Improved)
data.Description: When engaging in a chase or race, may suffer 2 strain to add [SU] equal to ranks in Shortcut to the check.

data.Name: Intuitive Evasion
data.Description: Perform the Intuitive Evasion maneuver; suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to ranks of Intuitive Evasion. Upgrade difficulty of combat checks targeting starship or vehicle by equal amount. Suffer 1 strain every round [FO] remains committed.

data.Name: Expert Tracker
data.Description: Remove [SE] per rank of Expert Tracker from checks to find tracks or track targets. Decrease time to track a target by half.

data.Name: Sense Advantage
data.Description: Once per session, may add [SE][SE] to 1 NPC's skill check.

data.Name: Intimidating
data.Description: May suffer a number of strain to downgrade difficulty of Coercion checks, or upgrade difficulty when targeted by Coercion checks, by an equal number. Strain suffered this way cannot exceed ranks in Intimidating.

data.Name: Toughened
data.Description: Gain +2 wound threshold.

data.Name: Balance
data.Description: When the character heals strain at the end of the encounter, he may add [FO] per Force Rating. He recovers additional strain equal to [LI] generated.

data.Name: Sixth Sense
data.Description: Gain +1 ranged defense.

data.Name: Coven
data.Description: May take the Coven maneuver. On the character's next Force power check, they may reroll one [FO] for each ally with Coven within short range.

data.Name: Ichor Transfusion
data.Description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Ichor Transfusion maneuver to heal any number of strain by suffering that number of wounds +1. The character may instead heal any number of wounds by suffering that number of strain +1.

data.Name: Survivor's Instincts
data.Description: Once per session when the character suffers a Critical Injury, spend 1 Destiny Point. Then, the attacker must roll two results for the Critical Injury and the player chooses which will apply to their character.

data.Name: Ichor Reserve
data.Description: Once per session as a maneuver, the character may suffer 2 strain to increase Force rating by 1 until the end of the encounter.

data.Name: Force of Will
data.Description: Once per session, make one skill check using Willpower rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
